body:
TASK-1641 (folded into TASK-1952): this needs one OPERATOR run on the live Claude Code. A nested agent session cannot run it, so I have not faked it.

WHERE: a plain terminal, NOT inside any Claude Code session (the test launches `claude -p` twice under the contained settings). Use an up-to-date main checkout or worktree. It costs two small model calls (haiku by default).

COMMAND (copy as-is):
  cd ~/ai/aida && git fetch -q origin && git checkout --detach origin/main \
   && git rev-parse HEAD && claude --version \
   && AIDA_TEST_REAL_CLAUDE=1 cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib \
        real_claude_contained_session_cannot_redirect_main_git_metadata -- --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee ~/tmp-task1641.log
(Optional: AIDA_TEST_REAL_CLAUDE_MODEL=sonnet, AIDA_TEST_CLAUDE_BIN=/path/to/claude. The fixture is created and removed under ~/.cache/aida-test-bug1982-*.)
If `--exact` matches nothing because the path is module-qualified, drop `--exact`.

EVIDENCE TEMPLATE (paste back into a TASK-1952 comment, or reply to this mail):
  TASK-1641 operator run
  - date/time:
  - aida HEAD (git rev-parse HEAD):
  - claude --version:
  - model:
  - result line ("test result: ok. 1 passed" / FAILED):
  - did it print "skipping:"? (must be NO, or the run proved nothing)
  - last ~20 lines of ~/tmp-task1641.log:
  - if FAILED: the assertion message (which metadata path changed, or "commit-failed" missing, or the seat-clone commit failing)

PASS means both halves held: the linked-worktree session could not write commondir, gitdir, config.worktree or <main>/.git/config, and could not commit; the seat-clone session committed while the same probes failed.
subject: TASK-1641 (TASK-1952): operator real-claude run — command + evidence template
